evidence.title: The VIX Explosion of 2024: Insights & Market Impact | tastylive
evidence.summary: This article, published on July 26, discusses the VIX reaching its highest level in nearly 10 months and closing above 20 for the first time since October 2023. It highlights that a VIX above 20 indicates a 'critical danger zone' and an 800% increase in risk compared to when the VIX is below 15. It also notes the VIX breaking above 15 on July 18, increasing risk by nearly 200%. This directly explains the mechanism of a significant VIX increase.
